assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL finished full-screen game-menu background for Rainbow Patrol, a painted vintage WWI biplane adventure game. Create a richly detailed 1536x1024 landscape illustration matching a high-quality Amiga adventure-game painting brought to higher resolution: warm oil-painted canvas, natural brush texture, tactile timber, leather, aged brass and subdued olive, believable charming human anatomy, no chunky pixels, no modern CGI or glossy vector style. View from inside a small 1917 airfield maintenance workshop, warm afternoon sunlight and one hanging brass lamp. CRITICAL INTERACTIVE LAYOUT: the LEFT 43 percent of the composition contains ONE large upright rectangular blank dark green-black slate maintenance board on a rough timber wall, almost front-on with absolutely straight parallel sides, from approximately x72 to x650, y100 to y870. Its dark EMPTY inner writing area must run x110..610,y145..825; uniform quiet very dark slate, subtle wiped chalk dust only, no writing, diagrams, symbols, dividers, knobs, clips or objects across it. It is the one place where live game settings will be laid out. Keep the whole slate unobstructed and no hands over it. Below it at lower-left is a small clear floor area for a separate live BACK control. RIGHT 57 percent: an original friendly WWI ground-crew mechanic wearing rolled shirt sleeves, dark braces and a battered flat cap stands on the right at a timber workbench, inspecting a brass-and-black headphone earpiece; full torso and hands visible. On workbench are an era-appropriate wooden radio box with brass dials, cloth-covered wires, a small oil can, spanners and a folded maintenance cloth. Behind him a spare wooden propeller, a cream/coral biplane nose and exposed radial engine just inside the open hangar/workshop, glimpses of bright grassy airfield and distant blue sky at far right. Natural deep spatial perspective on right, warm amber light on brass and wood; calm dark left, brighter detailed right. No separate game UI window, second chalkboard, additional noticeboard, computer monitor, screens, modern equipment, anachronistic electronics, title, letters, numbers, labels, logo, writing or typography anywhere. Entirely original art, no commercial game artwork. Do not bake any buttons or settings into the picture.
